questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] Which river is the longest in the world?
A. Amazon
B. Yangtze
C. Nile
Answer: C.
questions.de: Welcher Fluss gilt meist als der längste der Welt?
questions.en: Which river is usually named the longest in the world?

timeline.labelEn: John Hanning Speke reaches Lake Victoria, which he identifies as the source of the Nile
timeline.labelDe: John Hanning Speke erreicht den Victoriasee, den er als Quelle des Nils ausmacht

questions.notes: Wikipedia gives the Nile ~7,088 km as the longest river but notes the title is somewhat controversial (some measurements favour the Amazon); hence 'usually'.

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] Which type of learning is illustrated by the example, “A child feels hungry when they hear the sound of the lunch bell at school”?
A. Operant conditioning
B. Observational learning
C. Classical conditioning
Answer: C. Classical conditioning refers to the type of learning where two stimuli are repeatedly paired; a response that is at first elicited by the second stimulus is eventually elicited by the first alone. It was first described by Ivan Pavlov, a Russian physiologist known primarily for his work in classical conditioning with dogs.
questions.de: Welche Lernform, zuerst von Iwan Pawlow an Hunden beschrieben, zeigt ein Kind, das beim Klingeln der Mittagsglocke in der Schule Hunger bekommt?
questions.en: Which type of learning, first described by Ivan Pavlov with his dogs, is shown by a child who feels hungry on hearing the school lunch bell?

timeline.labelEn: Ivan Pavlov publishes his experiments on conditioned reflexes in dogs
timeline.labelDe: Iwan Pawlow veröffentlicht seine Experimente zu bedingten Reflexen bei Hunden
